system.description: You and three other casters chant in unison.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, but you may move it up to 5 miles.
outcomes.success: You move a landmark (a grove, a hill, a small pond, a ruin) up to 1 mile. The earth groans, but the move is seamless.
outcomes.failure: The ritual fails; the land will not be moved.
outcomes.ruin: It moves, but the land beneath it splits as it goes, swallowing whatever lies between. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
